title: Serialize audit hash-chain predecessor allocation
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that SecurityServices reads the latest audit entry and later appends the new entry as separate operations. Concurrent writers can use the same PreviousAuditHash and fork the hash chain. Evidence: MemorySmith.App/Services/SecurityServices.cs lines 908-969. Allocate predecessor and append atomically through a transaction or compare-and-swap, with concurrency verification tests.
